flows:
Navigate to https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ then Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in the browser.
Scroll down to the first claim card.
Read the first claim card and its verdict label.
Assert The card shows a README line number and a README quote.
Assert The card shows an expected value, an observed value and at least one screenshot.
Assert The card's verdict is "Verified".
Store The verdict label shown on the first claim card as 'first_card_verdict'.

assert: The card shows an expected value, an observed value and at least one screenshot.

summary:
Opened the README Lie Detector page and moved to the first claim card.
Read the first card, which included a README line reference and quote, expected and observed values, and screenshot evidence.
The first claim card’s verdict was “Verified.”
